name: Shawn Fennoy
source:
??? - zombie - m

Shawn is a shut-in without a friend in the world. With the knowledge that humans and duenkhy alike will reject him for being a potential danger, he keeps to himself and keeps his zombieism a secret. He staves off hunger pains by snacking all the time and deals with sleep problems by playing video games all night. He fears himself just as much as others do.

"S-sorry about the smell..."

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
